posts.post:
everyone has that one piece of clothing they’re terrified to wear because they don’t think they’re ‘cool enough’ yet. 

stop waiting for a personality upgrade and just put it on.
owning clothes you’ve never worn is just a collection of your past selves you’re not ready to let go of.
the most stylish people i know are usually the ones who hate shopping the most.
if you spend more time planning the outfit than actually being at the event, you’re doing it right.
